nodes.name: counselorApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client and type definitions for the counselor dashboard: career statistics, missing-skill analytics, student feedback CRUD (including multipart attachments), and paginated student lists.

nodes.name: useCounselorAddStudent.ts
nodes.summary: Hook powering the counselor's add-student workflow: single-student form validation/submission plus bulk import from an Excel (.xlsx) file, with draft persistence to localStorage.

nodes.name: useCounselorDashboard.ts
nodes.summary: Data-fetching hooks for the counselor dashboard's charts: career distribution, missing-skill breakdown (optionally filtered by career), and recent feedback list.

nodes.name: useCounselorFeedback.ts
nodes.summary: Data hooks for the counselor's student-feedback panel: fetching the assigned student list, a single student's detail info, and sending new feedback entries.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the counselor dashboard's type definitions for the main dashboard, feedback, and add-student features.

nodes.name: CounselorAddStudentView.tsx
nodes.summary: Page component for counselors to add students individually or via bulk Excel import, rendering the form, validation errors, and import results using the useCounselorAddStudent hook.

nodes.name: CounselorDashboardView.tsx
nodes.summary: Counselor dashboard page composing a career-distribution pie chart, a missing-skills bar chart, and a recent feedback list, each backed by its own data-fetching hook.

nodes.name: CounselorFeedbackView.tsx
nodes.summary: Large counselor feedback page: lists assigned students with search/filter, and a detail panel with tabs for roadmap progress, skill gaps, and sending/viewing feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: At over 1,500 lines this is one of the largest frontend components; RoadmapTab/SkillGapTab/FeedbackTab are good candidates to extract into their own files.

nodes.name: mentorApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client for the mentor dashboard: welcome alert, metrics, pending reviews, career distribution, assigned students, student portfolio lookup, feedback history/submission, and progress reports, each defensively unwrapping the response envelope.

nodes.name: roadmapEditorApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client for the mentor's roadmap editor: CRUD operations on career roadmap nodes and bulk saving of node canvas positions.

nodes.name: MentorDashboardView.tsx
nodes.summary: Mentor dashboard landing page composing the welcome banner, metric strip, and pending-reviews widget.

nodes.name: MentorDashboardWidgets.tsx
nodes.summary: Collection of presentational widgets for the mentor dashboard (welcome banner, metric strip/cards, pending-reviews list) plus placeholder stubs for insight and career-distribution widgets.

nodes.name: MentorEPortfoliosView.tsx
nodes.summary: Mentor-facing view listing assigned students' e-portfolios for review.

nodes.name: MentorFeedbackHistoryView.tsx
nodes.summary: Mentor view displaying the history of feedback previously submitted to students.

nodes.name: MentorHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared header/navigation bar for mentor dashboard pages, showing the active tab and a user menu with logout.

nodes.name: buildFeedbackFormData
nodes.summary: Builds a multipart FormData payload for submitting counselor feedback, including any file attachment.

nodes.name: validateForm
nodes.summary: Validates the add-student form fields (email format, required name/date/major/curriculum) and returns field-level errors.

nodes.name: useCounselorAddStudent
nodes.summary: Hook driving the add-student workflow: single-entry form state/validation/submission and bulk import of students from an uploaded Excel file, with a localStorage draft.

nodes.name: useCareerDistribution
nodes.summary: Fetches career-distribution statistics for the counselor dashboard pie chart.

nodes.name: useMissingSkills
nodes.summary: Fetches missing-skill statistics, optionally filtered by career, for the counselor dashboard bar chart.

nodes.name: useFeedbackList
nodes.summary: Fetches the recent feedback list shown on the counselor dashboard.

nodes.name: useStudentList
nodes.summary: Fetches the counselor's assigned student list for the feedback page.

nodes.name: useStudentDetailInfo
nodes.summary: Fetches roadmap progress, skill gaps, and feedback history for a single student.

nodes.name: useSendFeedback
nodes.summary: Hook wrapping the send-feedback API call with sending/sent state.

nodes.name: CounselorAddStudentView
nodes.summary: Page rendering the counselor add-student form, bulk Excel import UI, and results/errors, backed entirely by the useCounselorAddStudent hook.

nodes.name: renderCustomizedLabel
nodes.summary: Custom Recharts pie-slice label renderer for the career distribution chart.

nodes.name: CareerDistributionChart
nodes.summary: Pie chart of student career distribution, fetched via useCareerDistribution.

nodes.name: MissingSkillsChart
nodes.summary: Bar chart of the most common missing skills, filterable by career, fetched via useMissingSkills.

nodes.name: FeedbackList
nodes.summary: List of recent feedback entries shown on the counselor dashboard, fetched via useFeedbackList.

nodes.name: CounselorDashboard
nodes.summary: Counselor dashboard page composing the career distribution chart, missing-skills chart, and feedback list.

nodes.name: FilterDropdown
nodes.summary: Reusable labeled dropdown filter control used across the feedback page.

nodes.name: RoadmapTab
nodes.summary: Detail-panel tab rendering a student's roadmap progress.

nodes.name: SkillGapTab
nodes.summary: Detail-panel tab rendering a student's skill gaps.

nodes.name: FeedbackTab
nodes.summary: Detail-panel tab for viewing feedback history and composing/sending new feedback to a student, using useSendFeedback.

nodes.name: StudentDetailPanel
nodes.summary: Side panel showing a selected student's roadmap/skill-gap/feedback tabs, fetched via useStudentDetailInfo.

nodes.name: CounselorFeedbackPage
nodes.summary: Main feedback page listing assigned students (via useStudentList) with search/filter and opening the student detail panel.

nodes.name: MentorDashboardView
nodes.summary: Mentor dashboard landing page rendering the welcome banner, metric strip, and pending-reviews widget.

nodes.name: WelcomeBanner
nodes.summary: Greeting banner showing the signed-in mentor's name.

nodes.name: MetricStrip
nodes.summary: Row of metric cards summarizing the mentor's key stats, with loading skeletons.

nodes.name: MetricWidget
nodes.summary: Single metric display card used within the metric strip.

nodes.name: PendingReviewsWidget
nodes.summary: Widget listing students' pending review items (e.g. portfolios/roadmaps awaiting mentor feedback), fetched from mentorApi.

nodes.name: MentorEPortfoliosView
nodes.summary: Mentor view listing assigned students' e-portfolios for review.

nodes.name: MentorFeedbackHistoryView
nodes.summary: Mentor view listing previously submitted feedback entries, fetched via mentorApi.getFeedbackHistory.

nodes.name: MentorHeader
nodes.summary: Shared header/tab navigation bar for mentor dashboard pages with a logout action.
